sources.title: Local plan
sources.guard: Rows include current, emerging and historical plans; row existence alone is not adoption or in-date proof.

sources.title: Local plan boundary
sources.guard: Boundary indicates intended coverage but does not prove plan adoption, currency or policy applicability.

sources.title: Local plan housing number
sources.guard: Zero rows mean no platform records, not that authorities have no housing requirements.

sources.title: Site allocations — design consideration
sources.facts: Design stage Co-design; expected records unknown; no related dataset; last updated 2025-05-14.
sources.guard: Deprioritised design consideration is not a production dataset or adopted allocation.

sources.title: Site allocations — development plan document type
sources.facts: Authoritative category entity; entry date 2024-10-24; no geometry.
sources.guard: Category entity labels a document type and does not prove that a site allocation exists or is adopted.

sources.title: Planning Data API documentation
sources.facts: API exposes over 100 planning and housing datasets and coordinate queries.
sources.guard: API capability and a returned intersection are not completeness, legal advice or policy currency guarantees.

sources.title: Planning Data dataset catalogue
sources.facts: Catalogue groups 56 geography, 30 category and other dataset types.
sources.guard: Catalogue membership does not mean every dataset is complete, current or operationally suitable.

sources.title: Planning Data prototype map
sources.facts: Prototype map is automatically generated from platform data and exposes multiple layers.
sources.guard: Map display is not a legal search, title plan, definitive boundary or planning decision.
